name: 89014 · Henderson, NV
findings: ZIP 89014 (Henderson) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89014 (Henderson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Community organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 community organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
